reading_issues: Propagation Labs PNG (2523x2526). Measured from native pixels: height axis HS 129 cm at y=355.5 and 0 cm at y=1776.5 (11.02 px/cm); hardness gridlines K, P, 1f, 4f, F at x=340, 680, 1020, 1361, 1701 (340.3 px per index); temperature axis -7..0 C with 0 at the right axis (243.3 px per C). Layer boundaries from the table row lines: 25, 38.8, 44, 69, 87, 100, 116 cm. The 38.8 cm boundary (between FC and MFcr, both P) is only visible in the table row line (1349 px = 38.8 cm, kept as printed, not rounded). The 87-100 cm layer's hardness bar is drawn in the red 'failure layer' highlight and starts at the P gridline. The temperature dot at 90 cm is partly covered by the CT22RP label (centre read at 90 cm, -6.5 C); dots sit at 0, 10, 20, ... 110, 119 and 129 cm. Glyphs: '=' read as IF and the parenthesised three-circle cluster as MFcl (secondary); two linked circles on the 38.8-44 cm layer read as MFcr; square-with-rounded-top read as FCxr; '□(∧)' read as FC with secondary DH. Header surface grain is 'Precipitation Particles 2.0mm'. For the CT22RP failure, layer_grain IF uses the highlighted 87-100 cm layer (the line is at its base); the failure plane lies between the P- RG below and this P layer. Observer is printed as 'steve holeczi' (the SnowPilot chart of 2023-12-19 prints 'Stephen Holeczi').
